captions.linkedin:
Apollo 17 (1972) holds the record for total moonwalk time at about 22 hours. Apollo 16 follows with about 20 hours, and Apollo 15 with about 18.5 hours. Apollo 14 is last in this ranking with about 9.4 hours. Each later mission stayed longer than the one before it. Which space milestone do you find most impressive?
Source: NASA, Lunar and Planetary Institute
